instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品回收率'. The Committee is responsible for the assessment and communication of product safety risks related to the Group, or the formulation or implementation of risk control measures for product risks. If the PV Department detects a suspected product safety risk, it will convene the meeting in time and take risk control measures, including but not limited to the recall of the involved product, according to the assessment results of the meeting. During the Year, no major safety risk signals of products were recorded and no large-scale drug recalls occurred.
